heroImageAlt: White outdoor sofa, beanbags and cushions on a garden terrace above the sea
heroText: Jeanette Read is a British artist and designer whose work draws on the patterns, rhythms and movement of the natural world, particularly water and the sea.
shopDoorText: Jeanette's textile and homeware designs bring her colour and pattern into everyday objects, adding colour and energy to indoor and outdoor living.
artDoorText: JRS art explores order and chaos, repetition and disruption, working mainly in print and paint.
statement: A love of the outdoors, and of the ocean in particular, informs both her art and design work, with water pattern and fractional movement a constant fascination.
